questions.text: Which Italian subject pronoun means «we»?

feedback: Voi means you (talking to several people)

questions.solution: Noi = we; voi = you (plural), loro = they, lei = she
questions.hint: Its verb forms end in -iamo

questions.text: What does «non ... mai» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.always: Always is sempre; non ... mai is a negative

questions.solution: Non ... mai = never, e.g. non mangio mai carne = I never eat meat
questions.hint: It is the opposite of sempre

questions.text: What does «non ... niente» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Non ... niente (or nulla) = nothing, e.g. non faccio niente = I do nothing / I don't do anything
questions.hint: It is the opposite of qualcosa (something)

questions.text: Give the «io» form of «essere» in the present tense. Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Essere: sono, sei, è, siamo, siete, sono
questions.hint: Essere is irregular; the io and loro forms are the same

questions.text: Give the «loro» form of «avere» in the present tense. Type the verb only.

feedback.sono: Sono comes from essere; this question asks for avere

questions.solution: Avere: ho, hai, ha, abbiamo, avete, hanno
questions.hint: Avere is irregular; this form starts with a silent h

questions.text: Which word means «the» before a masculine plural noun such as «libri»?

feedback: Gli is used before vowels, s + consonant and z (gli amici, gli studenti)
Il is singular
Le is feminine plural

questions.solution: Masculine plural nouns starting with a consonant take i: i libri
questions.hint: Libri starts with an ordinary consonant (not a vowel, s + consonant or z)

questions.text: Which word means «my» before a feminine singular noun such as «sorella»?

feedback: Mio is masculine
Miei is masculine plural
Mie is feminine plural

questions.solution: Sorella is feminine singular: mia sorella (no article with a singular family member)
questions.hint: Sorella is feminine and singular

questions.text: Choose the correct article: «___ zaino è pesante.»

feedback: Before z or s + consonant, il becomes lo
Before z, un becomes uno

questions.solution: Masculine nouns starting with z or s + consonant take lo: lo zaino
questions.hint: Zaino is masculine and starts with z

questions.text: Which phrase is correct for «a little girl»?
questions.solution: Bambina is feminine: una bambina piccola
questions.hint: Check the article, the noun ending and the adjective

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include the definite article (il, lo, la, l', i, gli or le): the friends (a group of boys)

feedback.i amici: Before a vowel, the masculine plural article is gli
feedback.gli amichi: Amico has the plural amici (soft c)

questions.solution: Masculine plural nouns starting with a vowel take gli: gli amici
questions.hint: The noun starts with a vowel and is masculine plural

questions.text: Give the plural of «il problema», with its article.

feedback.le probleme: Problema is masculine, so the plural is i ...-i

questions.solution: Problema is masculine, so its plural is i problemi
questions.hint: Problema ends in -a but is masculine

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «Vado ___ cinema.»

feedback: Cinema is masculine, so alla is wrong
Allo is used before z or s + consonant
Ai is plural

questions.solution: A + il = al: vado al cinema
questions.hint: Cinema is masculine singular and starts with a consonant

questions.text: Complete with the word for «my»: «___ madre si chiama Anna.» Type the missing word only.

feedback.la mia: With a singular family member, Italian leaves out the article
feedback.mio: Madre is feminine, so mio is wrong

questions.solution: Madre is feminine singular: mia madre (no article with a singular family member)
questions.hint: Madre is feminine, and there is no article here

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «Le mie sorelle sono ___.» (tall)
questions.solution: Sorelle is feminine plural: alte
questions.hint: Sorelle is feminine and plural

questions.text: What does «Non mangio mai carne» mean?

options: I am not eating meat today
I eat a lot of meat

questions.solution: Non ... mai = never: I never eat meat
questions.hint: Look at the negative around the verb

questions.text: What does «Guarderemo un film» mean?

options: We would like to watch a film
We watch a film every day

questions.solution: Guarderemo is the future of guardare (noi): we will watch a film
questions.hint: The ending -remo shows the future

questions.text: Read: «Ieri ho giocato a tennis con Paolo.» When did this happen? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Ieri means yesterday
questions.hint: Look at the first word of the sentence

questions.text: Read: «Luca non beve mai caffè.» What does Luca never drink? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Caffè = coffee: Luca never drinks coffee
questions.hint: Look at the noun at the end

questions.text: Which sentence is in the passato prossimo?

feedback: Mangiavo is the imperfetto (I used to eat / I was eating)

questions.solution: Passato prossimo = avere/essere + past participle: ho mangiato
questions.hint: Look for avere or essere plus a participle ending in -ato

questions.text: Read: «Non mi piace per niente il pesce.» What does the speaker dislike? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il pesce = fish; non mi piace per niente = I don't like it at all
questions.hint: It lives in the sea or in rivers

questions.text: Complete with the passato prossimo of «andare»: «Ieri lei ___ al mercato.» Type the two missing words.

feedback.è andato: With essere, the participle agrees with the subject: lei needs -a

questions.solution: Andare takes essere and agrees with lei: è andata
questions.hint: Andare uses essere, and the subject is feminine

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «finire»: «Noi ___ alle cinque.» Type the verb only.

feedback.finisciamo: -isc- is not used in the noi form

questions.solution: Finire (an -isc- verb) has no -isc- in the noi form: finiamo
questions.hint: -isc- verbs do not add -isc- with noi and voi

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Quando ero piccolo, ___ al parco ogni giorno.» (io)

feedback: Giocavano goes with loro; the subject here is io
Giocherò is the future
Gioco is the present

questions.solution: A repeated past habit uses the imperfetto, and the subject is io: giocavo
questions.hint: Ogni giorno in the past describes a habit

questions.text: Choose the correct form: «A mio fratello ___ i videogiochi.»

feedback: Piace is for one thing; i videogiochi is plural

questions.solution: Piacere agrees with the thing liked; i videogiochi is plural: piacciono
questions.hint: With piacere, the verb agrees with what is liked

questions.text: Complete with the future tense of «avere»: «Domani ___ molti compiti.» (io) Type the verb only.

feedback.avrei: Avrei is the conditional (I would have)

questions.solution: Avere has the irregular future stem avr-: avrò
questions.hint: Avere drops the e in its future stem

questions.text: Replace «la televisione» with a pronoun: «Guardo la televisione.» → «___ guardo.»

feedback: Lo replaces a masculine noun
Gli is an indirect pronoun (to him)

questions.solution: La televisione is feminine singular: la guardo
questions.hint: Televisione is feminine and it is the direct object

questions.text: Which sentence in the passato prossimo is correct?

options: Lei ha andata in città ieri
Lei è andata in città ieri
Lei è andato in città ieri
Lei ha andato in città ieri

questions.solution: Andare takes essere and agrees with lei: è andata
questions.hint: Check the auxiliary first, then the agreement

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «I would like to travel to Spain»?

feedback: Countries take in, not a
Ho viaggiato means I travelled

questions.solution: Would like = vorrei; countries take in: in Spagna
questions.hint: Look for the conditional of volere and the preposition used with countries

questions.text: Which negative sentence is correct?
questions.solution: Non goes before the auxiliary, and Italian uses a double negative: non ho mangiato niente
questions.hint: Non comes before avere, and Italian needs niente, not qualcosa

questions.text: Translate into Italian using the passato prossimo: «they arrived» (a group of boys)

feedback.sono arrivato: With essere, the participle agrees: masculine plural -i
feedback.sono arrivate: The boys are masculine, so -i, not -e

questions.solution: Arrivare takes essere and agrees: sono arrivati
questions.hint: Arrivare uses essere; make the participle masculine plural

questions.text: Translate into Italian using the future tense: «I will eat»

feedback.mangiarò: In the future, -are verbs change -ar- to -er-
feedback.mangierò: Mangiare drops its i in the future
feedback.mangerei: Mangerei is the conditional (I would eat)

questions.solution: Future of mangiare: -are changes to -er- and the i is dropped: mangerò
questions.hint: -are verbs change -ar- to -er- in the future, and mangiare also drops its i

questions.text: Translate into Italian using the conditional: «we would go»

feedback.andremo: Andremo is the future (we will go); the conditional has a double m

questions.solution: Conditional of andare (noi): stem andr- + -emmo = andremmo
questions.hint: Andare has the stem andr- in the future and the conditional

questions.text: What does «il fratello» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il fratello = the brother
questions.hint: Think of the boys in a family

questions.text: What does «la zia» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.uncle: Uncle is lo zio; the -a ending shows a woman

questions.solution: La zia = the aunt (lo zio = the uncle)
questions.hint: She is your mother's or father's sister

questions.text: Which is the Italian for «grandfather»?
questions.solution: Il nonno = grandfather; la nonna = grandmother, il nipote = grandson or nephew, lo zio = uncle
questions.hint: It is the masculine form of nonna

questions.text: What does «il medico» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il medico = the doctor
questions.hint: This person treats people who are ill

questions.text: Which word means «tired»?
questions.solution: Stanco = tired; contento = happy, malato = ill, arrabbiato = angry
questions.hint: Think of how you feel after a long day

questions.text: What does «la colazione» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La colazione = breakfast (fare colazione = to have breakfast)
questions.hint: It's the first meal of the day

questions.text: Which word means «funny»?
questions.solution: Divertente = funny or fun; timido = shy, pigro = lazy, serio = serious
questions.hint: This person makes you laugh

questions.text: False friend! What does «il parente» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.parent: False friend: parents are i genitori; un parente is a relative
feedback.parents: False friend: parents are i genitori; un parente is a relative

questions.solution: Il parente = a relative; parents are i genitori
questions.hint: It's a false friend: think of aunts, uncles and cousins

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «Mia sorella è molto ___.» (intelligent)

feedback: Adjectives ending in -e do not change to -a in the feminine
Intelligenti is plural

questions.solution: Adjectives ending in -e are the same for masculine and feminine singular: intelligente
questions.hint: Adjectives ending in -e do not change for gender in the singular

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include the definite article (il, lo, la, l', i, gli or le): the hand

feedback.il mano: Mano is an exception: it ends in -o but is feminine

questions.solution: Mano is feminine even though it ends in -o: la mano (plural le mani)
questions.hint: This noun is an exception: it ends in -o but is feminine

questions.text: Which sentence means «I get up at seven o'clock»?

feedback: Vado a letto means I go to bed
Mi sveglio means I wake up, not I get up
Mi vesto means I get dressed

questions.solution: Alzarsi = to get up; svegliarsi = to wake up, andare a letto = to go to bed, vestirsi = to get dressed
questions.hint: Which reflexive verb means to get out of bed?

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include «un» or «una»: a waitress
questions.solution: Cameriere becomes cameriera for a woman: una cameriera
questions.hint: Start from the word for a waiter and make it feminine

questions.text: Choose the correct article: «Ho ___ capelli lunghi.» (I have long hair)
questions.solution: Capelli is masculine plural and starts with a consonant: ho i capelli lunghi
questions.hint: Capelli (hair) is plural in Italian

questions.text: What does «gli occhi» mean?
questions.solution: Gli occhi = the eyes; le orecchie = ears, i capelli = hair, i denti = teeth
questions.hint: You see with them

questions.text: What does «Mio padre è più alto di mia madre» mean?

options: My father is older than my mother
My mother is taller than my father
My father is as tall as my mother
My father is taller than my mother

questions.solution: Più alto di = taller than: my father is taller than my mother
questions.hint: Più ... di makes a comparison: more ... than

questions.text: Read: «Mio fratello è molto chiacchierone.» What is the brother like? Answer in English with one word.
questions.solution: Chiacchierone = chatty or talkative
questions.hint: He never stops talking!

questions.text: Read: «Mio zio è avvocato.» What is the uncle's job? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Avvocato = lawyer
questions.hint: He works in courts

questions.text: What does «Devo mettere in ordine la mia camera» mean?

options: I have to tidy my bedroom
I want to tidy my bedroom

questions.solution: Devo (from dovere) = I must / I have to; mettere in ordine = to tidy
questions.hint: Devo comes from dovere

questions.text: Read: «Per stare in forma, mangio frutta e non fumo.» What does the speaker do to stay healthy?

options: Eats fruit and does not smoke
Drinks water and does not smoke

questions.solution: Mangio frutta = I eat fruit; non fumo = I don't smoke
questions.hint: Find the two verbs: mangio and fumo

questions.text: Read: «La mattina faccio la doccia e bevo il tè.» What does the speaker drink in the morning? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Bevo il tè = I drink tea
questions.hint: It's a hot drink, often served with milk in Britain

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «alzarsi»: «Mio fratello ___ alle otto.» Type the two missing words.

feedback.mi alzo: Mi alzo is for io; mio fratello needs the lui form
feedback.alza: Reflexive verbs need their pronoun (si with lui)

questions.solution: Reflexive verb with lui: si alza
questions.hint: Use the reflexive pronoun for lui, then the lui form of alzare

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Mia sorella ___ diventare medico.» (wants to)

feedback: Voglio goes with io
Vogliono goes with loro

questions.solution: Volere with lei: vuole
questions.hint: Mia sorella = lei; which form of volere goes with lei?

questions.text: Complete with the correct form of «simpatico»: «Le mie cugine sono molto ___.» Type the adjective only.

feedback.simpatici: Simpatici is masculine plural; cugine is feminine
feedback.simpatice: Feminine plural -ca becomes -che to keep the hard sound

questions.solution: Feminine plural of simpatico: simpatiche (-ca → -che)
questions.hint: Feminine plural, and keep the hard c sound

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «L'anno prossimo mio fratello ___ all'università.» (will go)

feedback: Andrebbe is the conditional (would go)
Andava is the imperfetto
È andato is the passato prossimo

questions.solution: Future of andare (lui): andrà
questions.hint: L'anno prossimo = next year

questions.text: Complete with the imperfetto of «essere»: «Quando ___ piccolo, abitavo a Roma.» (io) Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Essere in the imperfetto with io: ero
questions.hint: Essere is irregular in the imperfetto; this is the io form

questions.text: Choose the correct form of «svegliarsi»: «Stamattina mi ___ alle sei.»

feedback: Reflexive verbs take essere, not avere
Sveglierò is the future

questions.solution: Reflexive verbs take essere in the passato prossimo: mi sono svegliato (svegliata for a girl)
questions.hint: Reflexive verbs use essere

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
questions.solution: Genitori is plural, so it keeps the article (i miei) and takes sono + simpatici
questions.hint: Plural family members keep the article

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «When I am older, I would like to be a vet»?

options: Quando ero più grande, volevo fare il veterinario
Quando sarò più grande, ho fatto il veterinario
Quando sarò più grande, vorrei fare il veterinario
Quando sarò più grande, faccio il veterinario

questions.solution: Italian uses the future after quando (sarò) and the conditional vorrei for would like
questions.hint: Look for the future after quando and the conditional of volere

questions.text: Which negative sentence is correct?
questions.solution: Non goes before the reflexive pronoun, and mai after the verb: non mi alzo mai presto
questions.hint: Non comes first, then the pronoun mi

questions.text: Translate into Italian: «she is tall and intelligent»

feedback.lei è alto e intelligente: Alto must agree with lei: alta
feedback.è alto e intelligente: Alto must agree with lei: alta
feedback.lei è alta e intelligenta: Adjectives ending in -e do not change in the feminine

questions.solution: Alta agrees with lei; intelligente is the same for both genders
questions.hint: Make alto feminine; adjectives ending in -e don't change

questions.text: Translate into Italian using the future tense: «I will work»

feedback.lavorarò: In the future, -are verbs change -ar- to -er-
feedback.lavorerei: Lavorerei is the conditional (I would work)

questions.solution: -are verbs change -ar- to -er- in the future: lavorerò
questions.hint: In the future, -are verbs change -ar- to -er-

questions.text: Translate into Italian: «my brothers are lazy»

feedback.miei fratelli sono pigri: Plural family members keep the article: i miei
feedback.mio fratello è pigro: That is singular (my brother is lazy)

questions.solution: Plural family members keep the article: i miei fratelli sono pigri
questions.hint: With plural family members, keep the article before the possessive

questions.text: What does «il nuoto» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il nuoto = swimming (nuotare = to swim)
questions.hint: It's a sport you do in a pool

questions.text: What does «il formaggio» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il formaggio = cheese
questions.hint: Parmigiano is a famous Italian one

questions.text: Which is the Italian for «the mobile phone»?
questions.solution: Il cellulare (or il telefonino) = the mobile phone; il telecomando = the remote control
questions.hint: It is also called il telefonino

questions.text: What does «gli scacchi» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Giocare a scacchi = to play chess
questions.hint: A board game with kings, queens and knights

questions.text: Which word means «the cake»?
questions.solution: La torta = the cake; il pane = bread, il pesce = fish, il pollo = chicken
questions.hint: You might have one with candles on your birthday

questions.text: What does «la canzone» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La canzone = the song (cantare = to sing)
questions.hint: It's related to cantare, to sing

questions.text: Which word means «Christmas»?
questions.solution: Natale = Christmas; Pasqua = Easter, il compleanno = birthday, Capodanno = New Year's Day
questions.hint: It is celebrated on 25 December

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Mio fratello ___ la chitarra.» (plays)

feedback: Giocare is used for sports and games, not instruments

questions.solution: Instruments use suonare: suona la chitarra; sports and games use giocare
questions.hint: Italian uses different verbs for instruments and for sports

questions.text: Choose the correct article: «___ sport è importante.»

feedback: Before s + consonant, il becomes lo
Gli is plural

questions.solution: Sport starts with s + consonant, so it takes lo: lo sport
questions.hint: Masculine nouns starting with s + consonant take a special article

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include the definite article (il, lo, la, l', i, gli or le): the music

feedback.il musica: Musica is feminine, so it takes la

questions.solution: Musica is feminine: la musica
questions.hint: Nouns ending in -a are usually feminine

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include the definite article (il, lo, la, l', i, gli or le): the newspaper
questions.solution: Il giornale (or il quotidiano) = the newspaper
questions.hint: It is masculine and ends in -e

questions.text: Which phrase means «cartoons»?
questions.solution: I cartoni animati = cartoons; le telenovele = soap operas, i quiz = quiz shows, il telegiornale = the TV news
questions.hint: Animati suggests animation

questions.text: What does «il telegiornale» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il telegiornale = the TV news
questions.hint: Tele + giornale (newspaper): a TV programme about today's events

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «Mi piace ___ cinema.»

feedback: Al means to the; piacere needs the article il
Lo is used before z or s + consonant, not before an ordinary consonant like c

questions.solution: With piacere, Italian uses the definite article: mi piace il cinema
questions.hint: Cinema is masculine singular and starts with an ordinary consonant

questions.text: What does «Preferisco guardare i film dell'orrore» mean?
questions.solution: Preferisco = I prefer; i film dell'orrore = horror films
questions.hint: Preferisco looks like an English verb

questions.text: Read: «Il sabato vado in piscina con mia sorella.» On which day does the speaker go to the pool? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il sabato = on Saturdays
questions.hint: It's the day before domenica

questions.text: Read: «Il mio piatto preferito è il pollo arrosto.» What is the speaker's favourite dish? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il pollo arrosto = roast chicken
questions.hint: Pollo is a bird you eat; arrosto is a way of cooking it

questions.text: What does «Passo troppo tempo sui social» mean?

options: I spend too much time on social media
I spend very little time on social media
I spent a long time on my phone

questions.solution: Passare tempo = to spend time; troppo = too much; i social = social media
questions.hint: Troppo means too much

questions.text: Read: «Per il mio compleanno, i miei genitori mi hanno regalato una chitarra.» What present did the speaker get? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Una chitarra = a guitar
questions.hint: It's a musical instrument with strings

questions.text: Read: «Non mi piace il rap, ma adoro il jazz.» Which statement is true?

options: The speaker likes both rap and jazz

questions.solution: Non mi piace il rap = I don't like rap; adoro il jazz = I love jazz
questions.hint: Ma (but) separates the two opinions

questions.text: Complete with the passato prossimo of «vedere»: «Lo scorso fine settimana ___ un bel film.» (noi) Type the two missing words.

feedback.abbiamo vedere: Use the past participle, not the infinitive

questions.solution: Vedere takes avere and has the irregular participle visto: abbiamo visto
questions.hint: Vedere uses avere and has an irregular past participle

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Domani ___ a tennis con i miei amici.» (io)

feedback: Giocavo is the imperfetto
Ho giocato is the passato prossimo
Giocheranno goes with loro

questions.solution: Domani points to the future: giocherò (the h keeps the hard c sound)
questions.hint: Which tense goes with domani, and which ending goes with io?

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «fare»: «La domenica ___ sport con mio padre.» (io) Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Fare is irregular: io faccio
questions.hint: Fare is irregular in the io form: it has a double consonant

questions.text: Choose the correct pronoun: «Ti piacciono le patatine? — Sì, ___ mangio spesso.»

feedback: La replaces a feminine singular noun
Li replaces a masculine plural noun

questions.solution: Le patatine is feminine plural, so the pronoun is le
questions.hint: Patatine is feminine plural

questions.text: Complete with the imperfetto of «guardare»: «Prima ___ la TV ogni sera.» (io) Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Imperfetto for a past habit: guardavo
questions.hint: Prima + ogni sera describes a past habit

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «È un ___ programma.» (good)
questions.solution: Before most masculine singular nouns, buono shortens to buon: un buon programma
questions.hint: Buono changes form before a masculine singular noun

questions.text: Which sentence about last night is correct?

options: Ieri sera abbiamo andato al concerto
Ieri sera siamo andati al concerto
Ieri sera siamo andato al concerto

questions.solution: Andare takes essere and agrees with noi: siamo andati
questions.hint: Check the auxiliary, the agreement and the tense

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «I don't like playing video games»?

options: Non mi piaccio giocare ai videogiochi
Mi non piace giocare ai videogiochi
Non mi piace giocare ai videogiochi
Non mi piace giocando ai videogiochi

questions.solution: Non goes before mi piace, and piacere is followed by the infinitive
questions.hint: Piacere is followed by an infinitive, not an -ing form

questions.text: Which sentence with «se» (if) is correct?

options: Se avrei soldi, comprerei una console
Se ho soldi, comprerei una console
Se avessi soldi, comprerò una console
Se avessi soldi, comprerei una console

questions.solution: Se + imperfect subjunctive (avessi), then the conditional (comprerei)
questions.hint: After se, Italian never uses the conditional

questions.text: Translate into Italian: «I play the guitar»
questions.solution: Instruments use suonare: suono la chitarra
questions.hint: Italian uses a special verb for playing instruments

questions.text: Translate into Italian using the passato prossimo: «she watched a film»

feedback.ha guardata un film: With avere, the participle does not agree with the subject

questions.solution: Guardare takes avere, so there is no agreement: ha guardato un film
questions.hint: Guardare uses avere, so the participle does not agree with lei

questions.text: Translate into Italian: «we are going to the restaurant»

feedback.andiamo a il ristorante: A + il always contracts to al

questions.solution: A + il = al: andiamo al ristorante
questions.hint: Use the noi form of andare, and remember what a + il becomes

questions.text: What does «la spiaggia» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La spiaggia = the beach
questions.hint: You find sand and the sea there

questions.text: What does «la stazione» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La stazione = the (railway) station
questions.hint: You catch a train there

questions.text: Which is the Italian for «it is raining»?
questions.solution: Piove = it is raining; nevica = it is snowing, fa bel tempo = it is fine, c'è vento = it is windy
questions.hint: Think of la pioggia (rain)

questions.text: What does «la panetteria» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La panetteria = the bakery (il pane = bread)
questions.hint: It comes from pane, bread

questions.text: Which word means «the plane»?
questions.solution: L'aereo = the plane; la nave = the ship, la macchina = the car, il pullman = the coach
questions.hint: You get on it at an airport

questions.text: What does «il municipio» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Il municipio = the town hall
questions.hint: The mayor (il sindaco) works there

questions.text: Which phrase means «the bedroom»?
questions.solution: La camera da letto = the bedroom; la cucina = the kitchen, il bagno = the bathroom, il soggiorno = the living room
questions.hint: Letto means bed

questions.text: False friend! What does «la libreria» mean?

feedback: False friend: the library is la biblioteca

questions.solution: False friend: la libreria is a bookshop; a library is la biblioteca
questions.hint: It's a false friend: think about where you buy books

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include the definite article (il, lo, la, l', i, gli or le): the library

feedback.la libreria: La libreria is a bookshop (false friend)
feedback.il biblioteca: Biblioteca is feminine, so it takes la

questions.solution: La biblioteca = the library; la libreria is a bookshop
questions.hint: It's feminine and it is not the false friend libreria

questions.text: Choose the correct phrase: «La banca è ___ cinema.» (next to)

feedback: Di fronte a means opposite
Dietro means behind

questions.solution: Accanto a = next to; di fronte a = opposite, dietro = behind, sotto = under
questions.hint: This preposition shows that something is beside something else

questions.text: Translate into Italian. Include the definite article (il, lo, la, l', i, gli or le): the car

feedback.il macchina: Macchina is feminine, so it takes la

questions.solution: Macchina is feminine: la macchina (also l'auto)
questions.hint: It is feminine

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence: «I live in London.»

feedback: In is used with countries and regions (in Italia)

questions.solution: Towns and cities take a: abito a Londra; countries take in
questions.hint: Italian uses different prepositions for cities and for countries

questions.text: What does «la periferia» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La periferia = the outskirts or suburbs of a town
questions.hint: It's the part of a town far from the centre

questions.text: Which phrase means «on the left»?

feedback: A destra means on the right
Sempre dritto means straight on

questions.solution: A sinistra = on the left; a destra = on the right, sempre dritto = straight on, di fronte = opposite
questions.hint: It is the opposite of a destra

questions.text: What does «Fa caldo e c'è il sole» mean?
questions.solution: Fa caldo = it is hot; c'è il sole = it is sunny
questions.hint: Caldo is a false friend: it does not mean cold

questions.text: Read: «Vado a scuola in bicicletta.» How does the speaker travel to school? Answer in English.
questions.solution: In bicicletta = by bike
questions.hint: It has two wheels and pedals

questions.text: Read: «L'estate scorsa sono andato in Francia con la mia famiglia.» Which country did the speaker visit? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La Francia = France
questions.hint: Its capital is Paris

questions.text: What does «La stazione è di fronte alla banca» mean?

options: The station is opposite the bank
The station is next to the bank
The station is behind the bank
The bank is opposite the post office

questions.solution: Di fronte a = opposite: the station is opposite the bank
questions.hint: Di fronte a is a preposition of place: think of facing something

questions.text: Read: «Nella mia città c'è troppo inquinamento.» What problem does the town have? Answer in English.
questions.solution: L'inquinamento = pollution
questions.hint: It is bad for the air and for the environment

questions.text: Read: «Per proteggere l'ambiente, riciclo e prendo l'autobus.» What does the speaker do?

options: Saves water and takes the bus
Turns off the lights and recycles

questions.solution: Riciclo = I recycle; prendo l'autobus = I take the bus
questions.hint: Find the two verbs after per proteggere l'ambiente

questions.text: Complete with the passato prossimo of «partire»: «I miei genitori ___ ieri per le vacanze.» Type the two missing words.

feedback.sono partito: With essere, the participle agrees: masculine plural -i

questions.solution: Partire takes essere and agrees with i miei genitori: sono partiti
questions.hint: Partire uses essere; make the participle masculine plural

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Se domani fa bel tempo, ___ al mare.» (noi)

feedback: Andremmo is the conditional (we would go)
Andavamo is the imperfetto

questions.solution: Se + present, then future: andremo
questions.hint: Se + present tense is followed by the future

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «uscire»: «Mio padre ___ di casa alle sette.» Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Uscire is irregular: lui esce
questions.hint: Uscire changes its first vowel in most present tense forms

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «Abito in una casa molto ___.» (beautiful)
questions.solution: Casa is feminine singular: bella
questions.hint: Casa is feminine

questions.text: Complete with the imperfetto of «fare»: «Durante le vacanze ___ molto caldo.» Type the verb only.

feedback.ha fatto: Ha fatto is the passato prossimo; this question asks for the imperfetto

questions.solution: Imperfetto of fare for describing the weather: faceva
questions.hint: Fare uses the stem fac- in the imperfetto

questions.text: Choose the correct pronoun: «Compri la maglietta? — Sì, ___ compro oggi.»

feedback: Lo replaces a masculine noun
Gli is an indirect pronoun (to him)

questions.solution: La maglietta is feminine singular: la compro
questions.hint: Maglietta is feminine and it is the direct object

questions.text: Which sentence about last year is correct?

options: L'anno scorso abbiamo andato in Spagna
L'anno scorso siamo andati in Spagna
L'anno scorso siamo andati a Spagna

questions.solution: Andare takes essere and agrees with noi, and countries take in
questions.hint: Check the auxiliary, the agreement and the preposition

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «We must protect the planet»?
questions.solution: Dovere + infinitive: dobbiamo proteggere; pianeta is masculine (il pianeta)
questions.hint: After dovere, the next verb is an infinitive

questions.text: Read: «Prima c'era un cinema nel mio paese, ma adesso non c'è più niente.» Which statement is true?

options: There is a new cinema in the village
There has never been a cinema in the village
The cinema is going to close soon
There used to be a cinema, but now there is nothing

questions.solution: C'era = there was / there used to be; non c'è più niente = there is nothing any more
questions.hint: Compare the imperfetto c'era with the present c'è

questions.text: Translate into Italian: «I went to the beach» (the speaker is a boy)

feedback.sono andata in spiaggia: The speaker is a boy, so andato

questions.solution: Andare takes essere: sono andato (masculine) + in spiaggia
questions.hint: Andare uses essere, and the speaker is male

questions.text: Translate into Italian using the future tense: «it will rain»

feedback.pioverebbe: Pioverebbe is the conditional (it would rain)

questions.solution: Future of piovere: pioverà
questions.hint: Add the future ending for lui to the stem piover-

questions.text: Translate into Italian: «there is a lot of traffic»
questions.solution: C'è = there is; traffico is masculine: molto traffico
questions.hint: Use c'è, and make the word for a lot agree with a masculine noun
